turns.learner: Hi teacher. Can I have an exercise about he, she, it in present simple?

Look: I run. She runs. We add -s to the verb after "she".
Rule: add -s or -es to the verb after he, she and it.
Right: He runs fast. Wrong: He run fast.
Now you try. Write only the verb.
